errors.evidence: The description fails to mention the y-axis and that its units are percentages, as indicated by the figure's caption. It also omits that the y-axis has no visible scale or labels.

errors.text_span: Скалата на хоризонталната ос е линейна и включва стойностите 21, 26, 74 и 84
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis is categorical, not linear. The values listed (21, 26, 74, 84) are data values from the tops of the bars, not labels on the axis itself.

The description incorrectly maps the categories to the colors. The legend shows that "Да" (Yes) is represented by teal/blue-green bars, and "Не" (No) is represented by yellow bars. The description reverses this and also misidentifies the yellow color as orange.
The description incorrectly assigns the value 21 to the 'Април 2021 г.' category. According to the chart, the value for 'Да' in April 2021 is 16. The value 21 corresponds to the 'От всички' category.
The description only mentions one of the three labels on the horizontal axis ("От всички"), omitting the other two categories: "Април 2021 г." and "Август 2021 г.".
The bars representing the "Не" (No) category are yellow, not orange as stated in the description.

errors.text_span: показвайки по-висок процент на ваксинирани хора през август 2021 г. в сравнение с април 2021 г.
errors.evidence: The prompt asks to avoid making comparisons unless explicitly intended by the chart design. While a time-series comparison is implied, stating one month is higher than another is an interpretation beyond a neutral description of the data points.
